title: ЗАКОН ЗА НОРМАТИВНИТЕ АКТОВЕ
evidence: The history line and the amendment rows show amendments in 2003, 2007, 2016 and ДВ 30/2026 (2026-03-27), with no repeal marker; every candidate is a general repeal decree of Council of Ministers acts, or an ordinance on transport subsidies, that shares only the word актове and does not name this law.
